rawContent: @RepKatieHill It isn't necessary that you resign, Katie, especially when we have gone through so much in the #metoo movement-this type of exploitation is a means to keep you quiet and docile-patriarchy is only enacted when we let them keep us from saying or doing what is in our best interest

@LincolnsBible It bothers me more that Trump the womanizer/alleged rapist is allowed to keep his job while Katie Hill, the democratic congresswoman has to resign...it's a double standard that should by all rights have been worked out before now when the #metoo groups were active. Never too late
